title: Joe Smith joining as Head of Platform
body:
Hi all,

Excited to share that Joe Smith is joining Lumen Freight as Head of Platform starting Monday. Joe previously led infrastructure at a logistics company and will oversee our API gateway, telemetry pipeline, and on-call rotation.

Please make him feel welcome and add him to the #platform channel and the eng-handbook repo.

Best,
Abraham
author: abrahamaiproject@gmail.com
